content: CodeMirror 6 default keymap does NOT bind Tab to acceptCompletion by default (deliberate, documented tradeoff). Ghost-text/ Copilot-style inline suggestions are built via Decoration.widget with a low-opacity '.ghostText' CSS class plus a custom Tab keybinding, not the built-in dropdown autocompletion. Prior art: codemirror-extension-inline-suggestion (npm), val-town/codemirror-codeium.
